_comment: DRAFT — deliberately NOT in projects/led_room/manifest/modules/ yet.
Dropping it there would register a module that never boots and never publishes
health, so the registry would carry a phantom node and its staleness warnings.
Move it (one per physical node) when the first node actually runs.
PLACEHOLDER VALUES — do not reason from these, they are not design decisions:
group.count = 6 is a stand-in taken from the number of dev boards on hand,
NOT a decision about the installation's size, which is unknown. Same for
group.index, geometry.logical (a 1/6 slice) and geometry.positionM — all wait
on strips being physically mounted in a real room.
OPEN: clock.main.* has no publisher in led_room yet (pain-material's SongClock
is the precedent, not a shared module).

subscribes._comment: Clock arrives as a (position, rate) tuple; PHASE IS EXTRAPOLATED LOCALLY on the node — never shipped sampled. Phase 7's SongClock contract.
